---
title: "Turn D1 unique constraint failures into validation errors"
description: "Drop when the pinned release turns D1's unique constraint errors into a ValidationError."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

On D1, saving a document with a duplicate value in a unique field returns a
500 instead of the 400 with "Value must be unique" on the field that SQLite
and Postgres give. handleUpsertError recognises a unique violation by the
driver error's code, 23505 on Postgres and SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE on
libSQL. D1 errors have no code. D1 puts SQLite's message and result code in
the message instead: "D1_ERROR: UNIQUE constraint failed: posts.slug:
SQLITE_CONSTRAINT (extended: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE)".

handleUpsertError now reads a D1 unique constraint failure from that message
and handles it as a SQLite one, so the field's path comes from the column in
the message. The match needs the message to start with "D1_ERROR:", which
Postgres and libSQL errors never do, so they take the same path as before.

- **Patch:** `d1-unique-constraint-errors`, committed as `fix(drizzle): turn D1 unique constraint failures into validation errors`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/drizzle/src/upsertRow/handleUpsertError.spec.ts; e2e suite (tests/database.spec.ts)`
